# `MC_knlGetResource`

Copy a packaged resource into an application-provided buffer.

## Prototype

```c
M_Int32 MC_knlGetResource(M_Int32 resourceID, void *buf, M_Int32 bufSize);
```

```{doxygenfunction} MC_knlGetResource
:project: libwipi
```

## Usage

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `resourceID` | Resource ID returned by MC_knlGetResourceID. |
| `buf` | Destination buffer. |
| `bufSize` | Destination capacity in bytes. |

### Return value

The provider-defined result code.

### Ownership

The caller owns the destination buffer and its copied contents.
